note: Sapper's Path v4 M4, the Gallery. convert: the converter (tools/convert.js). kinds: per kind of picture, its mask (alpha: emoji; flood: our generated pictures, flat backgrounds; none: paintings), the picture box [columns, rows] without the ring, the outline rings and the margin (cells of background plus outline round the subject's box); a kind may set its own minDE (never under 20), fadeDE and chroma. minDE: every pair of colours in a picture is at least this far apart (CIEDE2000; a colour closer to one already kept is left out and its pixels vote for their nearest kept colour). fadeDE: every pair also stays this far apart with one of them faded to a queue row behind the front (config.json layout.fade), as the siege's tiles do (tools/fade.js): a pair under it has its rarer colour's lightness moved `nudge` L* away, up to `nudges` times, else that colour goes; paintings set 0 (their muted tones are posterized already and the board is the point; tools/fade.js --gallery reports them). fadeFloor (Critics 2 fix, paintings 16): once the cells are voted, a pair still under it faded has its rarer colour's display lightness moved `nudge` L* away (up to `nudges` times a colour, never closer than minDE to another colour); the grid never changes, only the colours shown and their names. minShare: the least share of the subject a colour must hold to be kept. maxColours: the most colours a picture keeps (material ids 1-9 and 11-13). k0: k-means clusters before the choice. chroma (a kind): its colours' a* and b* are scaled by this before the choice (paintings). ink: the outline black. bgs: background colours an emoji may take: the first (pale ones first) bgGap past minDE from all its colours, else the farthest. names: colour names for aria-labels (nearest by CIEDE2000, all different). bake: see its own note. v4.2: the boxes are full-screen (39 x 39 for emoji and ours, 40 x 39 for paintings, without the frame: a 375x812 phone at 8 CSS px a cell) and the emoji margin is 3.

outlined.note: Campaign v6 side quests (Peter's ink-outline rule, 2026-10-06: one solid black line round the whole shape, no broken bits of black inside): the 'ours' look (a flood mask and a 1-cell ink outline) at the max phone box with a 5-cell margin, so an organic moat ring has room, and the land floors (minDE 20, no fade drop, the fade-floor lift to 16). Sources are cleaned of Flux's line art first (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/campaign-quests/scripts/clean.py); tools/quest-bake.js converts them through tools/land.js boardOf.

shade.note: Lands foundation, shading within a colour (tools/shade.js; the test that set these: game-research/sappers-path-v4/pd-art-test/shading, 20 paintings, shade-config.json). A cell's shade digit: its source lightness (the pixels voting for its own colour) minus the median of its colour's cells; >= t lighter, <= -t darker (levels 2: past t2 a second step). median: 3x3 same-colour median passes; minRegion: a smaller run of one shade goes back to the base. A shade colour: the base moved stepMax L* (x step2 for the second step), chroma -chroma lighter, +chroma darker. Floors (CIEDE2000): floor from every other colour's base and shades, margin more from those than from its own base, fadedFloor from every other colour's faded queue card (layout.fade), groundFloor from the frame's ground (or no nearer than its base); a failing shade steps in 1 L* to stepMin, then is dropped. Only levels whose land asks for it carry shade (tools/land.js); levels 1-200 and the Gallery have none.

bake.note: The Gallery bake (tools/gallery-bake.js). curve: the first `intro` pictures in the intro band, then `pattern` repeating (bands: Normal random-tap win rates). maxTaps, maxWaitMs and duration.maxMs as the siege (bake-config). capOf: the outline's squads (the ink colour): [first squad at most, every later one at most], so the first breach is narrow. deal, dealBy, tune, grade, fast, candidates, dedupe, penalty, budget: as the siege's bake-config. narrowFor: slots whose tuning also narrows the one-move-lookahead player's win rate (down to tune.narrow.stopAt, so a thinking player can lose there too). v4.2: squads of 45-99 are dealt (shrunk where a tap would run past the dead-time cap; more taps than the castles' 90-99 because a picture, with no moats, walks shorter), capOf is doubled for the longer outlines, and duration.pace sets the limits on the real pace as the Siege does, from 150 s (bake-config duration.pace; the patient maxMs no longer applies). v4.3: every picture has one fixed tag (tags) and is graded on it alone; the slot follows the tag (curve.byTag); a lost real-pace replay is a duration miss; pace.aim and aimWeight: among candidates meeting every target the picker prefers the real pace nearest aim (aimWeight ms from it weigh as one point of rate from the band's middle); pace.thinks: the stored order is also replayed waiting this many ms after each tap (reported). v4.3: a space frees at its squad's last pickup, so a picture plays about a seventh quicker on the same deal; the squads are dealt at 30-60 (more taps, each squad holding its space a shorter while), which brings the real pace back toward its v4.2 median (tools/v4.3-notes.md).

tags.note: v4.3 (tools/tags.js, as the Siege's bake-config tags): every picture plays on one fixed tag; the last picture is a Hard end, the first ones Easy, then the cycle (Gallery: 8 easy, 38 normal, 14 hard).

byTag.note: v4.3: the slot follows the tag (the intro stays): easy takes relief, hard takes hard; normal keeps its slot, with hard read as saw2 and relief as saw0.

deal.note: v5 R2: hold 5, the spaces every picture plays on (v4.3 dealt on Hard's 4 so a deal won on every tag).
